---
name: Source or interface correction
about: Correct one dated fact, source link, comparison or integration problem
title: "[Correction] "
assignees: ''
---

## Page, term or artifact

Link the affected page, comparison URL or JSON artifact. No ENS name is required.

## What needs correcting

Describe the current result and the result you expected. For a protocol fact, distinguish the EIP document status, fork assignment and network activation.

## Primary evidence

Link the relevant EIP, specification, official announcement or implementation documentation. Include the observation date if the fact can change.

For an interface problem, include short reproduction steps and your browser/device instead.

## Scope

Keep the report technical and public. Do not include private correspondence, credentials or personal contact details. A correction report does not itself change canonical registry definitions.
